purpose: Discover English search terminology and publication-time innovation or potential-impact indicators without an arbitrary Top-K cutoff.
design: deterministic sequential stratified sampling with dual novelty saturation

snapshot.role: historical coverage, provenance freeze, local seed/indexability checks, and optional offline verification

api.scheduler: round-robin across keys with remaining daily credit; continue on the other key when one is exhausted
api.citation_execution: cursor-paged OpenAlex filters with resumable checkpoints; reuse backward-reference records already present in the local evidence database

sampling.formal_pool_selection_order: OpenAlex seeded sample rank plus a frozen phase offset; this permits deterministic lazy pagination without reranking already reviewed records.
sampling.target_oversampling: one stratum for each frozen bootstrap target term
sampling.evidence_oversampling: one stratum for each frozen bootstrap evidence-role term
sampling.reason_no_field_strata: Search concept domains must emerge from evidence and therefore cannot be sampling strata.

sequential_review.round_unit: the next deterministic batch from every still-active discovery stratum
sequential_review.phase_reset_rule: After the search-frame phase freezes and formal query pools are registered, the consecutive dual-zero counter resets; both phases require an independent H2-approved freeze.
novelty_endpoints: new non-redundant English canonical search-term family
additional_stop_gates: all eligible indexable development seeds recalled
all eligible indexable hidden validation seeds recalled
all AI-H1 disagreements in reviewed batches adjudicated
forward and backward citation tracking of included reviews and indicator definition or validation studies produces no new endpoint in the required consecutive rounds

claim_boundary.allowed: systematic evidence mapping continued to preregistered terminology-and-indicator saturation
claim_boundary.not_allowed: exhaustive census of every bibliographic record matching the broad bootstrap expression
